title: The first letter: New Libraries Minister speaks
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: The new libraries minister has spoken, showing an interest in the field and an awareness of the Taskforce, amongst other things. He points out that his interest in volunteering has a bearing in libraries, which will be seen as a bad omen by many (especially paid staff) but he does single out young volunteers, which suggests he’s thinking more in terms of Reading Hacks. It’s a good thing he has already had at least one meeting with public libraries people, anyway.
